briefdescription.para: A flattened 2D matrix providing efficient storage and uniform access for a rectangular grid of elements.

detaileddescription.para: This container stores all elements in a single contiguous memory block (data) of size n_rows * n_cols using row-major ordering. Row accesses are contiguous in memory, while column accesses are resolved mathematically via strided views. Both provide $O(1)$ random access and native compatibility with C++20/23 ranges.

sect3.title: Example Usage
sect3.para: 1. Initialize the flat_matrix with an initializer list of rows, where each row is a list of elements.
2. Modify an element using 2D coordinates (row 1, col 2).
3. Append a new row to the bottom.
4. Append a new column to the right.

blockquote.para: [!IMPORTANT] Iterator Invalidation Policy
Iterator invalidation follows std::vector semantics: modifying the dimensions or structural capacity of the matrix invalidates all iterators, pointers, and references to its elements.
